constraints.name: valid_rooted_tree_representation
constraints.description: A sequence p_1..p_n is valid iff there exists exactly one index r such that p_r = r, and for all i ≠ r, following parent pointers eventually reaches r (no additional cycles). This ensures p encodes a rooted tree.
constraints.formal: ∃! r ∈ [1,n] : p_r = r ∧ ∀i ∈ [1,n], ∃k ≥ 0 such that p^k(i) = r

constraints.name: parent_label_domain
constraints.description: Each p_i must be an integer between 1 and n inclusive, because vertices are numbered 1 through n.

constraints.name: optimal_edit_distance
constraints.description: The output sequence must be a valid sequence that can be obtained from the input sequence a by changing the minimum possible number of elements.
constraints.formal: output s is valid ∧ |{i | s_i ≠ a_i}| = min_{t valid} |{i | t_i ≠ a_i}|
